Application, formats, and inactive resources

Boundary record
  • The current page loads project-authored HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without an external runtime script, hosted font, or stock image dependency.
  • The current source does not declare a separate license for the Lexicon Atlas application code. No dataset license is silently applied to that code.
  • The opening and About artwork is a user-supplied JPEG linked to Philippe Stuart's Facebook profile ↗. No separate artwork license was supplied; its inclusion records the user's direction, not an independent rights determination. Asset SHA-256: 5b52740e4cc581ada0857cbc4002bb7efd2254f713fcf0773a1ef9af77f3c43f.
  • ODict and StarDict are supported elsewhere in the workspace as packaging or interchange formats. Their contents retain each dictionary's own license, but neither format supplies records to this browser build and neither is counted as an active source above.
  • Optional AI support is only a caller-provided hook. No AI model or AI service is bundled with this build.

Coverage basis: dist/data/manifest.json with schema lexicon-atlas-data/4, plus the pinned upstream source and license records linked above. A polished label does not merge licenses or upgrade uncertain terms; conflicts remain visible for review.
